handoff.objective: Re-review the preimplementation v4 source-TT compiler bundle after every v3 blocker was versioned.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether target-redacted source compilation, advice freeze, closed IR plus AST audit, exact backend closure, componentwise accounting, frozen controls, and 29 mutations are sufficient to authorize source implementation.
constraints: Try to recover target information or mutation expectations in the source phase.
Check the source-visible files for target-bearing hashes, planted tuples, labels, coordinates, coefficients, or schedules.
Try to enumerate B^5 through a flattened or helper-mediated path while emitting a valid-looking IR.
Verify M18A, M18B, M26, M27, and M28 independently.
Do not require this toy compiler to beat direct B^5 enumeration.
Preserve the no-locator and no-ECDLP-improvement boundary.
completion_gate: No protocol field can hide source work, liveness, tuple access, target access, or mutation access.
The backend has an auditable exactness and build-identity contract.
The live mutation schedule reaches every major claim surface.
Passing and failing interpretations remain finite and model-bound.
handoff.return_format: Use the repository handoff headings and end with one next concrete action.
